title: Original-g coherence with the finite derived-D lift
statement: Let C be an abelian category and X a type-zero bigraded exact couple [def-sp-exact-couple]. Let I_n(p,q):D_n(p,q)\to D(p,q) be a family of monomorphisms, with I_0 the identity and I_{n+1} the derived-D inclusion followed by I_n. Fix r natural and p,q integer. Suppose initialG(p,q) factors through the finite cycle subobject Z_r(p,q) [def-sp-convergence]. For any e:D(p,q)\to D_r(p-r,q+r) whose composite with I_r(p-r,q+r) is alphaIter r(p,q), the composite of e, derived g_r, and the canonical endpoint transport to E_r(p,q) equals the factorization of initialG through Z_r followed by the canonical projection Z_r\to E_r. No zero-D or half-plane hypothesis is required.

proof.text: For a type-zero bigraded exact couple X [def-sp-exact-couple], construct canonical epimorphisms e_n from original D(p,q) to D_n(p-n,q+n): at zero use the endpoint identity; at a successor use e_n and the image epimorphism of incoming alpha_n with the canonical bidegree transports. Induction on the prescribed recurrence of I and DerivedMaps.alpha_comm proves I commutes with original alpha. Thus e_n followed by I_n is alphaIter n [def-sp-convergence], using associativity and the equality of the appended and prepended recurrences. Any e in the statement equals e_n by cancellation of monic I_n.

Induct on n for the g equation. At zero the composite is initialG, and projection_zero and factorThru_arrow identify it with the stated cycle projection [def-sp-convergence]. For the successor derive the factorization through Z_n from hg through Z_(n+1) using Z_decreasing. The new factorThru followed by ofLE equals the old factorThru, because their composites with the monic arrow of Z_n both equal initialG.

DerivedMaps.g_comm [def-sp-exact-couple] identifies e_(n+1) followed by g_(n+1) with transported e_n followed by gToCycles and derivedEProjection. The previous induction equality and cycleLift_comm [def-sp-convergence] say that the latter kernel lift and the new initialG factorThru followed by cycleLift have equal composites with kernel.ι. Cancel this monic inclusion, compose with derivedEProjection, and use projection_succ. Compose endpoint eqToHom maps by their equality proofs to obtain the claimed target (p,q). Replace the canonical e_n by the supplied e using the uniqueness proved in the first step.

theorem finiteCycle_derived_comparison (X : BigradedExactCouple C 0)
    (I : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), (X.pageCouple n).D p q ⟶ X.D p q)
    (hI0 : ∀ p q : ℤ, I 0 p q = 𝟙 _)
    (hIs : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), I (n + 1) p q =
      (X.pageCouple n).derivedDInclusion p q ≫ I n p q)
    (hImono : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), Mono (I n p q))
    (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ)
    (hg : (X.cycleBoundaryTower.Z r p q).Factors (X.initialG p q))
    (e : X.D p q ⟶ (X.pageCouple r).D (p - r) (q + r))
    (he : e ≫ I r (p - r) (q + r) = X.alphaIter r p q) :
    e ≫ (X.pageCouple r).g (p - r) (q + r) ≫
        eqToHom (by congr 1 <;> omega) =
      (X.cycleBoundaryTower.Z r p q).factorThru (X.initialG p q) hg ≫
        X.cycleBoundaryTower.projection r p q
